version_control_status_at_execution: local uncommitted predeclaration; first Git commit occurs after the completed batch
purpose: Collect four independently configured TurtleBot3 recovery-followed-by-success development instances after e019 validated the mechanism and capture boundary.
inclusion_rule: Include each instance only if simulator/capture gates pass, one accepted goal and matching successful result are captured, recovery-count history is complete, one or two unique Wait attempts are recorded, and evaluator truth confirms hold and release.
mismatch_rule: Retain every attempted instance. Do not rerun, replace, change its configuration, or relabel its family after observing its outcome.
independence_basis: Instances have distinct fixed geometry/goal/intervention configurations and seeds. Questions within an instance remain one cluster; the four instances are not four different mechanisms.
evidence_boundary: Mobility intervention identity/timing remain evaluator-only. Robot-visible explanations may state only captured action/BT mechanisms and must withhold physical cause.
